summary: Yorkville International Capital Corp. filed an 8-K solely to announce the separate trading of its Class A ordinary shares and warrants from its units, effective July 13, 2026. This is a routine post-IPO administrative step—no M&A, governance change, or special situation event. Units (YICCU) remain listed; separated shares (YICC) and warrants (YICCW) will trade on Nasdaq. No transaction terms, premium, or strategic review are involved. The filing contains no special-situation catalyst, making it a 'None' classification.
